The Forward Deployed Engineer

AI models bahut capable ho gaye hain — lekin kisi customer ke enterprise ke andar unhe production me chalana ek alag kaam hai. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) woh engineer hai jo customer ke environment ke andar jaakar, unke data aur systems par, custom agents aur workers banata hai, security review se nikaalta hai, aur result ki zimmedari leta hai. Ye SPA usi book ko Hinglish me samjhati hai — sidebar se koi bhi section kholo, beech-beech me 8 interactive labs me haath se try karo, aur ant me Interview FAQs aur Trust Check ke saath apni taiyaari pakki karo.

01Chapter 1 · Founder · Chapter 1

The Founder Inside Someone Else's Company

Subah ke 4 baje ek Slack message aaya — phone par customer ke engineering director ka naam chamka, aur main laptop se bahut door tha. Maine unke liye ek data sync pipeline banayi thi, jo merger ke dauraan do companies ke systems ko jod kar rakhti thi. Woh pipeline clean ship hui thi, clean chal rahi thi — lekin sync ke kuch ghante baad user data galat jagah land karne laga. Yeh ek alarm tha.

Failure mere kaam ke downstream tha, ek aise process me jo mera tha hi nahi — lekin poori picture sirf main hi dekh sakta tha. Unki engineering team jaagi hui thi aur lost thi, kyunki unhone yeh system banaya hi nahi tha. Unki Customer Experience (CX) team jaagi hui thi aur help karne ko taiyaar thi, lekin jo screen par dikh raha tha woh padh nahi sakti thi. Director jaaga hua tha aur uska patience khatam ho chuka tha. Aur contract ke hisaab se mera kaam to kab ka khatam ho chuka tha.

Toh subah 4 baje, phone se, main ek saath kai jobs ban gaya — woh jobs jinke liye maine kabhi apply hi nahi kiya tha. Engineering manager, jo narrow down kar raha tha ki galti kahan hui hogi. Project manager, jo decide kar raha tha ki kaun, kya, kab tak check karega. Site-reliability engineer, jo door se kisi aur ka process walk kar raha tha. Maine jo prove kar sakta tha woh likha, thread unke CX lead ko handover kiya, aur ghar gaya.

Yahi FDE hota hai

Yeh kahani batati hai ki Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) hona kya hota hai — kai hats ek saath, decisions, aur woh soch jo sab kuch jodti hai. Isiliye kisi chhoti si job posting me yeh role samjhana itna mushkil hai. Kisi bhi FDE se poochho ki woh kya karta hai, toh woh haath hila kar bolega, "Bahut saari cheezein."

Is chapter ka kaam hai uss hand-wave ko ek definition me badalna. Aage hum dekhenge: title ke aas-paas ka noise aur woh ek cheez jo usse kaat kar saaf karti hai; naam, uski history, aur woh roles jinse FDE ko confuse kiya jata hai; kyun AI ne is role ka modern version banaya, use khatam karne ke bajay; woh founder comparison jiss par poori book chalti hai; aur FDEs asal me kya build karte hain. Role me aane ka rasta — interview aur career path — Chapter 11 tak wait karega, kyunki jis job ko tum samjhe hi nahi, uske liye interview kaise doge?

FDE ka matlab, ek line me

  • FDE ek engineer hai jo customer ke environment ke andar jaata hai, samajhta hai ki asal me kya banana hai, use build karta hai, customer ki security review se nikaalta hai, unke production systems me ship karta hai, aur jawab deta hai ki woh kaam karta hai ya nahi.
  • Mandate: woh cheez jiske liye job tumhe asal me accountable rakhti hai — chahe posting me likha ho ya na ho. Koi tumhe mandate deta nahi hai; woh outcome ke saath aata hai.
  • Hiring bar: ek aisa engineer jise tum kisi bhi strong software engineering team me hire kar loge, aur jise tum apne sabse important customer ke saath akele ek room me bitha doge. Dono halves ka weight barabar hai.

Hiring bar ke do halves

Pehla half hai poora engineering bar: yeh insaan production software ship karta hai, aisa code likhta hai jo codebase ke owners ki review me tik sake, aur aisi cheezein banata hai jo uske jaane ke baad bhi chalti rahen. Jo sirf room carry kar sakta hai lekin ship nahi kar sakta, woh dusre hafte tak pakda jata hai.

Dusra half hai woh rare cheez — kyunki uss room me engineer hi company hota hai. Woh jo promise karega, woh tumhari company ka promise hoga. Woh mushkil sawaal ko jis tareeke se handle karega, wohi tumhari company ka tareeka hoga. Ek FDE ko hire karna ek single person par bet lagana hai: "yeh engineer mera, meri company ka, aur hum jis cheez ke liye khade hona chahte hain, uska representation hai."

Yaad rakho: Contract khatam ho sakta hai, ownership nahi. Subah 4 baje kisi ne tumhari job description check nahi ki thi — failure contract ke bahar tha, lekin ownership ke andar tha, aur wahi second wala count karta hai.
SOURCESource: The Forward Deployed Engineer, O'Reilly, Chapter 1 — The Founder Inside Someone Else's Company

01.1Chapter 1 · Founder · Chapter 1

The Noise and the Mandate

Tumne yeh title shayad waisi hi dekha hoga jaisa most engineers dekhte hain — recruiter ka ek cryptic message, kisi colleague ka achanak title change, ya ek posting jiska compensation number dekh kar tum requirements do baar padhte ho. Title achanak har jagah hai. Sabse capable models banane wali companies engineers ko customer organizations ke andar embed kar rahi hain, taaki woh models ko aise systems me badal sakein jo production me chalein.

Posting count badh raha hai, aur is role ke baare me behes field ki sabse public voices tak pahunch chuki hai. Koi role public me tabhi argue hota hai jab woh define hone se tez create ho raha ho.

Definitional chaos — same title, alag jobs

Companies same teen words post karti hain aur alag-alag jobs mean karti hain. Kuch ka matlab hota hai solutions engineer, bas naya title laga diya. Kuch ka matlab hota hai support engineer, bas travel budget de diya. Kuch ka matlab hota hai sales engineer, jiska demo ab ek agent hai. Kuch ka matlab hota hai software engineer, jo bas customer ke paas baitha hai.

Aur kuch ka matlab hota hai asli cheez jiske baare me yeh book hai: ek engineer jo customer ke environment me chalta hai, samajhta hai ki asal me kya exist karna chahiye, use build karta hai, customer ki security review se nikaalta hai, unke production systems me ship karta hai, aur jawab deta hai ki woh kaam karta hai ya nahi.

Farq skills me nahi, ownership me hai

Dhyan do — jo description asli role ko baakiyon se alag karti hai, woh skills nahi hain, tools nahi hain. Farq hai role kya own karta hai:

  • Solutions engineer (naya title) — configuration own karta hai.
  • Support engineer (travel budget) — tickets own karta hai.
  • Sales engineer — demo own karta hai.
  • Software engineer — code own karta hai.
  • Asli FDE — outcome own karta hai, start se finish tak, aur outcome ko tumhare badge se koi farq nahi padta.

Subah 4 baje kisi ne meri job description check nahi ki thi — escalation mere paas aayi kyunki failure mere contract ke bahar tha lekin meri ownership ke andar tha, aur second wala hi count karta hai.

Mandate kya hai?

Mandate woh hai jiske liye job tumhe asal me accountable rakhti hai, chahe posting me likha ho ya na ho. Koi tumhe mandate grant nahi karta. Woh outcome ke saath aata hai. Toh jab koi posting tumhare saamne aaye, title ko padh kar aage badho — dekho ki role asal me kya own karta hai.

Engagement triangle

Mandate ke neeche ek structural fact hai jo is book me aage sab kuch shape karta hai. Ek FDE ek company ka employee hota hai aur dusri company ke andar deployed hota hai. Paycheck vendor se aata hai — woh AI company ya platform jiska product tum deploy kar rahe ho. Lekin tumhare din customer ke andar beette hain, jinke systems aur logon me woh kaam rehta hai. Yeh arrangement hai engagement triangle, aur yeh poori book me chalta hai.

  • Employer ka corner: chahta hai ki deal expand ho.
  • Customer ka corner: chahta hai woh outcome jo usne khareeda tha.
  • Tumhara corner: tumhari judgment — asal me kya build hona chahiye — tumhari standing dono sides ke saath, aur result par tumhara naam.

Teeno corners mostly aligned hote hain aur kabhi identical nahi hote — aur is job me judgment ka zyada hissa yahi decide karna hai ki jab woh alag-alag kheenche, tab kya karna hai. Customer ne tumhe hire nahi kiya, lekin unka trust decide karta hai ki kuch ship hoga ya nahi, aur unki renewal decide karti hai ki tumhara employer saal ko kaise measure karega. Jab yeh book kehti hai ki stakeholders tumhare nahi hain, toh iska matlab yahi arrangement hai. Chapter 3 is triangle ko ek working method me badalta hai; Chapter 11 ise career me badalta hai.

Ek aur baat: is role ka koi canonical reference isiliye nahi hai, kyunki jo log use likh sakte hain woh customer environments ke andar kaam me heads-down hain, aur us confidentiality me wrapped hain jo kisi aur ke systems ke andar baithne ke saath aati hai. Toh role me aane ki koshish karne wale engineers use job postings se reconstruct karte hain — aur posting requirements ki list hoti hai, kaam ki description nahi. Koi posting tumhe nahi batati ki poori cheez ek saath hold karna kaisa hota hai: discovery call jisme customer keh nahi sakta use kya chahiye, build, security review, go-live, aur uske baad ka phone call — sab kuch tumhara.

Yaad rakho: Posting padhte waqt title ko ignore karo, ownership ko padho. Jo role outcome own karta hai, wahi asli FDE hai — baaki sab lookalikes hain.
SOURCESource: The Forward Deployed Engineer, O'Reilly, Chapter 1 — The Noise and the Mandate

01.2Chapter 1 · Founder · Chapter 1

Old Term, New Job

Job ko properly define karne se pehle naam ko handle karna zaroori hai, kyunki naam hi confusion ka pehla source hai. Yeh naam us job se ek decade se zyada purana hai jise woh aaj describe karta hai.

Palantir origin

Palantir ne ek decade se zyada pehle Forward Deployed Engineer title ke under engineers ko customer sites par bheja tha. "Deployed" lagbhag literal tha. Woh engineers headquarters se nikal kar government agencies aur industrial customers ke andar baithte the, aur product ko customer ke data aur customer ki problems ke against kaam karwate the. Woh embedded the, customer-facing the, aur accountable the — aur yeh model itna achha chala ki title company ke monopoly se bahar bhi zinda raha.

Original ko uska credit do: kisi aur ki organization ke andar baithne ke baare me jo kuch bhi yeh book sikhati hai, uska bahut hissa pehle unhi logo ne seekha tha jinke paas woh badge tha.

Original FDE: solutions engineer, configurator

Lekin original FDE core me ek solutions engineer tha. Platform pehle se exist karti thi. Kaam tha use configure karna: existing product ko customer ke data aur workflows ke hisaab se adapt karna, edges par integrations wire karna, aur customer ke itna kareeb rehna ki adaptation asal need se match karta rahe. Demanding, skilled kaam — lekin phir bhi configuration hi tha.

Engineer ki ceiling platform ki ceiling thi. Agar product woh cheez nahi kar sakta tha, toh engagement bhi woh cheez nahi kar sakti thi, aur engineer ka kaam tha woh nearest cheez dhoondhna jo product kar sakta tha.

Maps-frontend weekend story

Pehtli jobs me engineers abhi bhi ek famous kahani sunate the: Maps ka frontend, acquisition ke baad slow aur bloated, ek engineer — [Name] — ne ek weekend me rewrite kar diya, aur Monday tak bundle size dasve hisse ka reh gaya. Woh kahani ek tier ko mark karti thi. Woh pace ek alag species ke engineer ki thi, aur baaki log use legend ki tarah repeat karte the.

Woh tier ab khatam ho chuka hai; woh weekend ab ek competent engineer ke liye ek ordinary weekend hai — coding agent ke saath. Jo badla hai woh hai ki ek single engineer ab kisi aur ki deewaron ke andar kya build kar sakta hai. Models production kaam karne ke capable ho gaye: customer ke documents padhna, unke tasks par reason karna, unke tools ke through act karna. Aur us capability ko working software me badalne ki cost collapse ho gayi — ek shift jise agla section, Why AI Created the FDE, properly khol kar batata hai.

Ceiling shift — adaptation se creation tak

Uss shift ne ceiling ko move kar diya. Aaj ka Forward Deployed AI Engineer ab kisi pre-built platform ke shape tak limited nahi hai, aur isiliye deliverable adaptation se creation me badal gaya. Aisa software jo engagement se pehle exist hi nahi karta tha: customer ki specific problem ke liye design kiye gaye custom agents aur workers, customer ke apne data par khada kiya gaya retrieval, integrations jo unki security review se bachne wale interface ke through thread hui hain, aur in sabse pehle — legacy data ko aisi state me migrate karna jahan production system use kar sake.

Title carry over hua, aur lagbhag kuch aur nahi.

Yaad rakho: Purana FDE finished product ko adapt karta tha — uski ceiling platform ki ceiling thi. Modern FDE raw materials se naya system banata hai, customer ke environment ke andar. Title wahi hai, job lagbhag poori nayi hai.
SOURCESource: The Forward Deployed Engineer, O'Reilly, Chapter 1 — Old Term, New Job

01.3Chapter 1 · Founder · Chapter 1

Drawing the Borders — Flavors of the Role

Role apne neighbours ke saath constantly confuse hota hai, isiliye borders par precise hona worth hai. Tumhe yeh borders sirf interviews ke liye nahi chahiye honge.

Teen neighbours — kahan border hai?

1. Solutions architect — design karta hai, advise karta hai, build nahi karta. Woh customer ki problem ko architecture se map karta hai, diagram banata hai, demo chalata hai, aur build kisi aur ko handover kar deta hai. Kaam real hai aur aksar excellent hai, lekin woh deal aur design par measure hota hai — aur jab system teesre month me girta hai, solutions architect dusre account par hota hai.

2. In-house AI engineer — codebase par build karta hai jo uski apni hai. Woh conventions jaanta hai kyunki unhe set karne me usne help ki thi. Uske paas accumulated context hai, hallway ke end par ek product manager hai, aur colleagues hain jinhone woh code likha tha jise woh extend kar raha hai. Uske hard constraints mostly technical hain, aur jab woh stuck hota hai, toh woh chal kar uss insaan se pooch sakta hai jo jaanta hai. Yeh saare advantages exactly woh hain jinke bina FDE andar chalta hai. In-house engineer ki craft transfer hoti hai; uski working conditions nahi.

3. Consultant — diagnose karta hai aur recommend karta hai. Deliverable ek document hoti hai, kabhi-kabhi ek prototype, aur engagement production shuru hone se pehle khatam ho jati hai. Consultants aksar sahi hote hain. Lekin jab sahi hona test hota hai, tab woh rarely wahan hote hain.

Har neighbour FDE ke saath ek edge share karta hai. Solutions architect customer-facing design work share karta hai. In-house engineer build share karta hai. Consultant diagnosis share karta hai. Lekin koi bhi pehli discovery call se lekar customer ke production environment me chalte hue system tak poora kaam own nahi karta, aur koi bhi tab accountable nahi rehta jab woh system apni pehli real Monday morning se milta hai.

Borders kyun matter karte hain?

Yeh sirf interview ki baat nahi hai. Real engagement par customer tumhe kisi na kisi point par tumhare neighbours me se ek banaane ki koshish karega. Woh tumhe solutions architect treat karega aur build ke bajay ek deck expect karega. Woh tumhe apna in-house engineer treat karega aur tumhe tickets ka backlog de dega jinka engagement se koi lena-dena nahi hai. Woh tumhe consultant treat karega aur recommendation ke liye thank you bolega, phir use implement karne ke liye apni hi team ko de dega.

Borders jaanna hi woh tareeka hai jisse tum notice karte ho ki yeh ho raha hai — aur shrink ko refuse karna hi job hai. Har neighbour kaam ka ek piece own karta hai. Yeh role poora kaam own karta hai, chahe tum role ke kis version me khade ho. Aur versions postings jitna batati hain, usse zyada differ karte hain.

Role ke teen flavors

Asli definition ke andar, role teen flavors me aata hai, aur yeh jaanna ki posting kaunsa mean karti hai, tumhe ek kharab interview se bacha lega.

  • AI labs: FDE frontier models ke upar strategic customers ke andar build karta hai. Engagement partly yeh prove karne ke baare me hai ki model kar hi kya sakta hai — matlab triangle me tumhare employer ka corner sabse zyada press karta hai: deal platform ko demonstrate karne ke liye exist karti hai, aur demonstration par tumhara naam hota hai.
  • Product companies: FDE company ka platform enterprise customers ke andar deploy karta hai aur woh custom layer build karta hai jo product cover nahi karta. Yahan customer ka corner sabse zyada press karta hai. Unhone outcome khareeda hai, proof of concept nahi — aur product jo karta hai aur unhe jo chahiye, uske beech ka gap exactly woh gap hai jise close karne ke liye tumhe hire kiya gaya tha.
  • Consultancies aur integrators: Palantir-classic shape yahan survive karta hai, apni origins ke sabse kareeb. Jo platform deploy ho raha hai, woh tumhare employer ka ho hi, yeh zaroori nahi — matlab tumhara apna corner sabse zyada press karta hai: tum ek aise system ke liye jawab de rahe ho jo triangle me kisi ne banaya hi nahi, sirf apni judgment ki taakat par.

Spine — teeno flavors me same

Job ki spine teeno me identical hai:

  • The mandate: tum kiske liye accountable ho, end to end.
  • The whole of the work: pehli discovery call se lekar go-live ke baad ke phone call tak, chahe posting me likha ho ya na ho.
  • The turf: tum kiski ground par yeh karte ho. Data, systems, security model, aur stakeholders — sab customer ke hain, aur "Their Turf, Your Outcome" — jo is chapter me aage aata hai — isi fact par built hai.
  • The outcome: result ke liye kaun jawab deta hai. Tum. Na woh account executive jisne use becha, na customer ki team jo use inherit karegi. Tum.

Same spine, teen flavors, aur flavor sirf yeh decide karta hai ki triangle ka kaunsa corner tumhe pehle feel hota hai. Jo koi flavor nahi badalta, woh hai woh economics jisne is role ka modern version pehle jagah banaya — aur chapter ab wahi jaata hai.

Yaad rakho: Neighbour sirf ek piece own karta hai, FDE poora kaam own karta hai. Customer tumhe shrink karne ki koshish karega — borders pehchanna aur shrink ko refuse karna hi job hai.
SOURCESource: The Forward Deployed Engineer, O'Reilly, Chapter 1 — Drawing the Borders — Flavors of the Role
